evidence.text: The page describes 房-seal.svg as a vector depiction of 房 in Shuowen seal-script style, identifies sources including the Sinica database, and marks the representation public domain. The file is a modern digital redraw, not an artifact photograph. Its description page exposes the original image link directly.
evidence.title: File:房-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: The page labels its displayed categories 楚系簡帛文字, 小篆, and 說文, and identifies 戶 as the semantic element and 方 as the phonetic element. The glyphs themselves were not visually inspected.
evidence.title: 漢字「房」：字形演變

evidence.source: Shuowen.org, 說文解字 entry with Duan Yucai commentary
evidence.field: historical gloss and received graph analysis
evidence.text: The entry defines 房 as a room beside the main room and analyzes it as 从戶方聲. Duan Yucai explains that the central room of a hall is flanked by east and west rooms, and notes an extended use for a compartment of a ritual vessel. This is a historical lexicographic account, not independent proof of the graph's first formation.
evidence.title: 說文解字「房」 - Shuowen.org

evidence.source: Fudan University Center for Excavated Documents and Paleography, Li Shoukui
evidence.text: The article discusses the Baoshan Chu slips and identifies a 房 graph on slip 149 as an example involving the Chu form of 戶; it describes the short upper horizontal as an optional decorative mark. This supports a local graphic variation, not a semantic extension or the earliest attestation. The cited slip image was not visually inspected.
evidence.title: 李守奎：包山楚簡120——123號簡補釋

evidence.text: The Commons description page's original-file link resolved to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/03/%E6%88%BF-seal.svg?utm_campaign=index&utm_content=original&utm_source=commons.wikimedia.org. Opening that direct image URL failed with a cache-miss error in the web tool. The path was obtained from the page link, not guessed.

search_audit.query: Wikimedia Commons 房 seal.svg 房-seal historical character; 房 字形 楚簡 戰國 房 字形演變; 房 seal script character Shuowen glyph Wikimedia Commons
search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced a Commons seal-style candidate, Sinica form labels, and Guoxuedashi's Warring States report. Opened the Commons description, Sinica record, Fudan article, and Shuowen.org entry. Guoxuedashi page open failed with cache miss.

search_audit.query: Direct image from the original-file link on the Wikimedia Commons 房-seal.svg page
search_audit.outcome: The Commons page exposed this exact original-file URL. Opening it failed with a cache-miss error; the description page's public-domain rights statement and candidate identity were inspectable.

gaps: The Commons direct-image request failed, so the candidate's pixels and successful download were not confirmed. The URL is recorded exactly as returned by the source page.
The Academia Sinica page labels historical-form categories and component roles but its character database rights notice says All Rights Reserved; no Sinica image is proposed.
The Xiaoxuetang query supplied no candidates because the query was unavailable with HTTP 401; no image candidate can be selected from it.
No ancient artifact image was visually inspected. The selected candidate is a modern digital redraw in Shuowen seal-script style, not an artifact photograph.
The Warring States first-graphic-attestation statement was found in search results, but the Guoxuedashi page could not be opened during this invocation. It remains unverified here.
The retrieved primary dictionary analysis supports 戶 as semantic and 方 as phonetic; the additional suggestion that 方 also conveys ‘side’ is not established by that analysis.

items.period: Small seal script style, representing the form tradition transmitted in the Shuowen Jiezi; modern vector file created in 2024
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 房 in Shuowen seal-script style. Shuowen analyzes the character as 戶, indicating the semantic element, with 方 as the sound element.
items.alt: Modern black vector rendering of 房 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The inspected Commons file page identifies this specific 房 image as Shuowen seal-script style and states that the image representation is public domain. It offers an educational comparison for the received 戶-plus-方 analysis; it is not a photo of an ancient inscription.
items.rights: Public domain, as stated on the Wikimedia Commons file description page; attribution appreciated.

limitations.text: The direct image URL was extracted from the Commons page's original-file link, but the web tool could not open it because of a cache miss. Candidate identity and licensing were checked on the description page; pixel-level inspection and successful retrieval remain unconfirmed.

The Sinica record provides labels for Chu manuscript/silk forms, small seal, and Shuowen, and identifies 戶 and 方 roles, but no Sinica image is proposed because the record states All Rights Reserved. The Xiaoxuetang per-character query returned no candidates.
